name: @whytide/api
description: The NestJS host that mounts the modules' API

scripts.generate: node ../../packages/db/src/cli.ts generate && node ../../packages/providers/_pattern/generate.ts && node ../../packages/ai/registry/generate.ts && node ../../modules/signals/scripts/kinds-generate.ts && node scripts/modules-generate.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run generate && pnpm run modules:build && tsc -b
scripts.test: pnpm run build && APP_ENV=test PROVIDER_AUTH=fake PROVIDER_LINKEDIN=fake node --env-file-if-exists=../../../.env.local --enable-source-maps --test "dist/tests/*.test.js"
scripts.serve:e2e: pnpm run build && APP_ENV=test node --env-file-if-exists=../../../.env.local --enable-source-maps dist/tests/e2e-server.js
scripts.openapi:build: pnpm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../../.env.local dist/openapi/build.js && node ../../../tools/ci/secret-shapes.ts core/apps/api/openapi.generated.json
